summary: Held the entire episode. Price moved favorably almost immediately (+55pts by t=2m) and oscillated in a wide but consistently positive band (roughly +18 to +90pts) through 19 frames, with each pullback recovering rather than breaking below entry -- never once traded negative. The one worrying stretch (t=11m-15m, sliding from +88.75 down to +18.50 with both HA/PROPP fires flipping against) looked like it could be a real reversal, but price stabilized and then rallied back to +73.50 by the final frame, confirming it was a deep-but-normal pullback, not a wrong-direction entry. Next time I'd watch for a break below zero (not just giveback%) as the real wrong-direction tell, since giveback alone was noisy and this trade proved giveback>50% is survivable when the underlying leg amplitude keeps expanding.
